title: Kernel counit and the prescribed proper inverse-projection counit
statement: Let q:X → Y be proper with finite coefficients A, B an arbitrary complex on X, D a trace-diagonal datum on B, and τ:Rq_*B → A_Y an ordinary trace. Suppose D.trace is canonical proper coincidence followed by τ and the canonical single-complex tensor-unit comparison. Then composing the kernel counit with the inverse source tensor symmetry gives exactly finiteP1TraceCounit A q B τ, the prescribed inverse ordered-projection counit. This compares actual natural-transformation components on every unbounded complex and asserts no triangle. The definitions and interfaces used here are [def-asd-presented-projective-line-trace-model] [lem-sf-diagonal-kernel-integral-triangles] [lem-asd-source-proper-projection-coincidence].

proof.text: Proper coincidence commutes with the original projection map. Use the existing projection-formula coherence equation and cancel the two projection isomorphisms to obtain the equation for their inverses. Naturality of proper coincidence moves the inverse source symmetry through that comparison.

Expand the ordered ordinary projection as the original proper projection conjugated by tensor symmetries. Its inverse has the reverse factors. Naturality of the target braiding moves the trace from the left tensor factor to the right tensor factor, and the braiding with the unit identifies the left and right unitors. Substitute the hypothesis on D.trace and the actual component formulas of both counits; associativity gives the asserted equality.

theorem finiteP1TraceCounit_kernel_comparison
    (A : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing A] [Finite A]
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (q : X ⟶ Y) [IsProper q]
    (B : DerivedCategoryModule A X) (D : TraceDiagonalDatum A q B)
    (τ : (ordinaryFinitePushforward A q).obj B ⟶ ordinaryFiniteUnit A Y)
    (hτ : D.trace =
      (rightDerivedLowerShriekIsoRightDerivedLowerStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) q).hom.app B ≫
        τ ≫ (singleFunctorObjUnitIso (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) Y).hom)
    (K : DerivedCategoryModule A Y) :
    (rightDerivedLowerShriek (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) q).map
        (((derivedTensorSymmetry (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) X).inv.app B).app
          ((ordinaryFinitePullback A q).obj K)) ≫ (SfDiagonalKernel.counit A D).app K =
      (finiteP1TraceCounit A q B τ).app K
